title: Resorting To Happiness | KEY.co
description_expanded: Perfectly situated between the serene waters of Powell Lake and the powder-soft sands of the Gulf, Resorting to Happiness offers a refined coastal escape in the heart of Inlet Beach. This luxurious five-bedroom, four-and-a-half-bathroom retreat is designed with elegant ease in mind, blending modern sophistication with laid-back beachside charm. Inside, spacious living and dining areas flow effortlessly into a chef’s kitchen with premium appliances, creating an ideal space for gathering. With two king suites on the top floor, a third king bedroom on the second, and flexible sleeping arrangements on the first, the layout is crafted for both comfort and connection. Multiple balconies—including private ones off each upstairs bedroom—invite moments of quiet reflection, while the rooftop terrace offers a showstopping space to entertain or unwind with panoramic Gulf views. Downstairs, a bonus lounge with a wet bar adds yet another place to relax after a day at the beach. Just beyond the front door, access to Grande Pointe’s amenities and a private boardwalk to Powell Lake promise adventure on and off the water. Whether enjoying sunset dinners on the rooftop or exploring the charm of nearby 30A, every element at Resorting to Happiness is curated for unforgettable moments along Florida’s Emerald Coast.
